title: Claude and I made a plugin that lets all your agents send you videos, screenshots and questions to one place.
author: Tricky-Situation2405
selftext:
**The problem**

Agents are excellent at coding and terrible at knowing how things look, feel or sound in practice. And if you have enough agents running, its your own context that rots. Things get committed without being actually looked at, you forget which session is doing what and what clanker you should be keeping tabs on. It's a mess that leads to half baked work and pain for future you.

**The Fix**

There may be many, but for me it's what I dubbed the agent review inbox! A tool that makes the agents record clips of their work, post them to an all-in-one inbox, and wait for your verdict. I've answered 1,200+ items through it in the last 2 weeks alone, so it's safe to say that it's been a giant timesaver *and* helped *so* much with the headaches that come from running and keeping track of lots of sessions. 

So, I figured other people might find it useful as well and spent a couple hours converting it into an open source plugin for everyone. (For the best results for in-engine work, point it at your engine's own recorder pls, your agent can set that up quickly)

**Feedback & Disclosure**

It's only tested in Claude Code so far, so if there are any issues, please let me know, either here or in the issues section of the repo, and uh, potentially have your own agents fix them for you in the meantime. Thanks!

[https://github.com/trickstack/agent-review-inbox](https://github.com/trickstack/agent-review-inbox) <- Free! and open source, obviously

Lastly, I'm curious, what's the worst thing an agent put in your project because nobody looked at it? Mine made an enemy jaw "open" upward through its own head, that was a terrifying sight.
